name: Samoa COVID-19 test line list
notes:
Samoa COVID-19 test line list v2.10
This report generates a list of all patients that have received a COVID-19 test. Each row represents a lab request and includes patient, 'COVID-19 Sample Collection Form' survey and lab request information.  Patients are listed in chroological order by requested date. 

Lab requests with a status of Cancelled, Deleted or Entered in error are excluded from this report.
